integrity.proof_status: Complete argument stated for all finite simple base graphs over every finite characteristic-two field; critical Jordan and inverse identities stated explicitly.
integrity.provenance: Mathematical claims and bibliographic sources cited; no external validation is asserted.
integrity.reproduction: checks/check_matrix.py and checks/check_orbits.py are standalone exact arithmetic programs; output files accompany them.

scientific_limitations: Applies to characteristic-two fields and coronas with exactly one private pendant neighbor per original vertex.
The converse rules out a threefold power-of-two order when the base adjacency is nonnilpotent, but does not determine other possible global orders.
The 2004 foundational article was accessible through its publisher abstract but not an independently inspected full text; priority under equivalent terminology remains uncertain.
Finite matrix and state-enumeration checks support, but do not replace, the algebraic proof.
title: Nilpotent-base coronas have exactly threefold dyadic reversible-wave clocks
